releaseInvariants: Human authority remains above Actor and Agent.
Mold is a permissioned operating contract.
Opening or configuring a specialist never executes.
Make Production is the sole Production execution transition.
Human acceptance is final and role-specific.
Local Gummy Box works without an account.
Night Gummy and Day Gummy are the only canonical expressions.
The exact five-color source palette remains unchanged.
Specialist-native and Gummy OS Receipts remain distinct and linked.
Production-specific choices do not silently become Actor memory.
Public Meshmallow naming preserves all historical 3D Bee identifiers and evidence.
Simulated and genuine results are never conflated.
knownLimitations: VideoBoss starts with one high-severity dependency advisory that must be repaired before release.
Live ImageHoss execution cannot be reproved on this machine without the supported ComfyUI runtime.
Live VideoBoss rendering cannot be proved without a supported provider credential.
Live Meshmallow artifact output cannot be proved without supported Blender.
Managed Box, Drive, production GitHub connector, Gummy Rooms live runtime, broad social, enterprise, federation, and marketplace remain outside the local-first release target.
